description: The share of PRIM calls of this Paris hour is gone (or the daily cap is reached), and the server holds no answer of the stop younger than 5 minutes. It tries again at the start of the next Paris hour that has calls left (the next Paris day once the daily cap is reached). retryAt is the time; Retry-After gives the same time in seconds from the answer. The request is at 2026-10-02T08:30:00Z (10:30 in Paris), so the server tries again at 09:00:00Z (11:00 in Paris).
